criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Portal claims ability to create bespoke characters, props, and scenes from scripts, but preservation of exact affiliate portfolio product geometry and branding in the opening 10 seconds remains 0/20 verified until hands-on evaluation.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Vendor claims cinematic AI-generated films and showcases example clips, but independent AIVP output artifacts do not exist; temporal consistency and motion quality remain unresolved.

criteria.name: Control & consistency
criteria.notes: Web interface features scene direction controls for tone, pace, light, score, and look with multi-take options, but repeatability across identical prompts and cut consistency remain unverified.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Official 3-step self-serve workflow (upload script, configure characters/props/scenes, build trailers/shows/movies) is publicly documented on the portal; real-world friction and scene assembly latency remain unverified.

criteria.name: Speed & reliability
criteria.notes: VentureBeat reports film generation in minutes, but server queue latency, multi-model render duration, and failure rates are untested.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Portal states 'Free to try', but VentureBeat reported estimated generation costs of $75 to $500 per finished minute; debit limits and retail pricing tiers remain unresolved.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Portal claims '100% of the rights and the creative decisions stay with the storyteller', but commercial terms across third-party underlying foundation models in Cinematica remain unverified.

criteria.name: Automation & integration
criteria.notes: VentureBeat confirms no public API at launch and that Inkitt's MCP server is not yet connected to the Cinematica production tool.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Web application is accessible in Australia via browser, but Australian creator rollout verification, regional performance, and local billing remain unverified.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: Strong creator interest in AI script-to-movie generation; no verified affiliate program exists.

analysis: Public beta launch of Inkitt Movie Creator powered by the Cinematica orchestration harness introduces a structured 3-step script-to-film creation flow with direction sliders. However, verified floor is held to 14/100 because output quality, prompt repeatability, exact-product preservation, and true credit economics remain unverified, with estimated compute costs of $75-$500/min blocking hands-on testing.
confidence_notes: Primary vendor portal and VentureBeat reporting only; no AIVP output render; output quality and repeatability unresolved; Confidence C / Monitor only.
